title: Vale consolidated interim financial statements at June 30, 2026
excerpt: For the first half of 2026, net income attributable to Vale shareholders was US$3.268 billion and diluted earnings per share were US$0.77.
summary: The current IFRS filing supports earnings, balance-sheet, cash-flow, liability, share-count and per-share evidence needed to assess the sponsored ADR without relying on market-data fundamentals.
